INSERT INTO account
            (id, public_key, created_at, updated_at)
        VALUES
            ($1, $2, $3, $3)
        ON CONFLICT
            (public_key)
        DO UPDATE SET
            public_key = EXCLUDED.public_key
        RETURNING
            id as "id!: uuid::Uuid",
            public_key as "public_key!: crypto::PublicKey",
            eulen_id,
            created_at as "created_at!: time::OffsetDateTime",
            updated_at as "updated_at!: time::OffsetDateTime"
